name: slo-burn-forecaster
description: Forecasts SLO error-budget burn from SLI data you paste (timestamped good/total, errors/total or error-rate rows per service) and each service's SLO target and period. Computes in code the multi-window burn rates (1 h, 6 h, 24 h, period), the error budget left, the hours until it runs out at the current rate, a status per service (fast burn, slow burn, elevated, healthy, exhausted) and which service is burning fastest. Optionally lists possibly related error-tracker issues and incidents for the top burners. Read-only: it never queries a metrics system and never claims a number it did not compute.

skills.name: SLO burn forecast
skills.description: Ranks services by error-budget burn from pasted SLI rows: burn rate per window, budget remaining, hours to exhaust, worst 6-hour window and share of errors, with what-if factors and per-service SLO overrides. All maths in code; read-only.
examples: Paste checkout and payments error counts and SLOs: which one runs out of budget first?
What if payments' error rate halves?
